lists.unresolved_reason: what the rows mean is unresolved: three columns are constant, the mutable ones are an ascending index, a class-0 sample key and two parameter bytes. The only row byte the corpus writes is +9 (FUN_800adb48), and the comparison that picks a row lives in `LAB_800ae184`, a label with no decompiled body — so which fields the search compares, and what the parameters mean, are not established. Row array plus sorted index is all this artefact asserts. (The keys that resolve to no pool record are not dangling references but the sentinels either side of a class range: 0 below the class-0 floor, 2027 one above its ceiling, 0x8149 one above class 2's.)
lists.width_evidence: not a u16 key run: read as u16 the walk runs past the record end on 287/417 records. With the u16 at +6 == 1 (287 records) the field is {u16 count, u16 0} followed by count 12-byte rows, and 4 + 12*count closes the record exactly on 287/287; those rows have constant columns (+4 = 0xff on 3068/3068, +5 = 0x0a on 3068/3068, +7 = 0x40 on 3068/3068, +9..+11 zero on 9204/9204) and their u16 at +0 strictly ascends on 6/287 arrays, which is what FUN_800ab43c binary-searches. With the flag == 0 (130 records) the field is 8-byte rows closed by 0xffffffff (closed on 130/130), with columns +4 = 0xff and +6/+7 zero on 754/754 rows, and the two u32 at record+0x20 address the two further 8-byte row tables that close the record's tail (130/130 records chain exactly).
